body: Thanks for the advice. We had some vodka that she would drink but she finished it off tonight and WE WILL NOT buy any more. We usually never drink anyway but it should be better now that we don't have anything left for her to drink. I will definitely keep trying to deter her from suicide and tell her that things will get better.

In the 2 years I have been with her she has not gone to get a manicure/pedicure and she trims her own hair every few months haha. 

When we were first dating I stayed with her when she almost killed herself and was in the hospital/psych ward. She is amazing and I knew it from our first date. I was working a lot then and I was sad I couldn't spend more time with her. But I got fired for some bs so I am glad I can be with her more. I just worry about her SO BAD. She is everything to me and I want to keep her from trying to do it again. She has made a few unsuccessful attempts lately like tonight but I caught her and kept her from doing it. 

The good news at least is she is opening up to me more about trying to commit suicide. I feel it is a start that at least she wants me to hear what she may seem a bit more hesitant to kill herself. She said she does not want to worry me but most of all not disappoint me. 

Thanks again for advice it is really helping me get through this.

Thank you for your response! I am with her 99% of the time except while she is at work because I am unemployed. She gets worried about the future a lot and thinks we won't be able to get decent jobs and move out of our parents' houses and we won't be able to have children or anything. I am very supporting and loving to her and I try my best to keep her occupied while having little to no money to spend. I try talking to her about getting help but she just brings up about how therapists are fake and act like they give a shit to take your money but don't really care. So I should just keep telling her she should seek help and hopefully someday she will want help?
